Common questions

Is the estimate free?

Yes. Estimates are free and come with no obligation.

What should I include in my request?

Where the job is, what needs to be done, the rough size and when you need it. If you have photos of the site, you can send them once we get in touch.

Do you need to see the site?

For most jobs a visit gives a more accurate number than a description. Access, measurements and soil all change the price.

How accurate is the dirt calculator?

It is a planning guide: length × width × depth ÷ 27 gives cubic yards, and we add 25% because loose soil takes up more room. It is not a quote.

What areas do you serve?

All over the Phoenix valley, including Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Tempe, Glendale, Peoria, Goodyear, Avondale, Tolleson and Maricopa. If you are not sure your site is in range, ask in the form.

Do you speak Spanish?

Yes. We take calls in English and Spanish, and this site has a Spanish version.

What about underground utilities?

In Arizona, underground lines have to be located through Arizona 811 before digging. Ask us how that fits your timeline.

Got dimensions? Get a price.

The calculator is a guide. We come to the site, measure, check access, and give you a real number.

Privacy Policy

Effective October 28, 2026.

Who we are

CD Services LLC is an excavation and grading company in Phoenix, Arizona. Contact: estimates.carranzadig@gmail.com, cdsexcavation@gmail.com or info@cdigs.bid.

What we collect

Only what you type into the estimate form: name, phone, city or area, email (optional), the work you need, when you need it, how you prefer to be contacted, your language and any details you add. We also receive the page you came from, if your browser sends it.

How we use it

  • To answer your request and schedule your estimate.
  • To follow up about the job by call, text or email, as you chose.
  • To keep ordinary business records.

Who sees it

We do not sell your personal information or share it for advertising. It goes to the service providers we use to host this site, deliver requests to our team and send email, only to do that job. We may disclose it if the law requires.

Cookies and storage

This site stores only two things on your device: your language and your cookie choice. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies today. If we ever add analytics or other optional cookies, they will not run without your permission.

Text messages

If you choose text, we will message you about your request. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP any time to opt out.

How long we keep it

As long as needed to handle your request and keep our records, then we delete it or strip the identifying details.

Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information, or to stop contacting you, by writing to estimates.carranzadig@gmail.com, cdsexcavation@gmail.com or info@cdigs.bid. This site is not directed to children under 13.

Changes

If we change this policy we will post the new version here with its date.
